risks.title: Cyberattacks and System Failures
risks.score_rationale: Risk ranks at the top of cited factors, with actual attacks experienced and mounting threats. Language emphasizes potentially material impact despite non-significant historical impact. Central positioning in 10-K and active reinforcement of measures indicate high severity. Cybersecurity category heavily weighted.

risks.title: Responsible AI Adoption
risks.score_rationale: Explicit mention of notable AI impact on operating environment. Company required rapid response with governance programs. Proactive language but emphasizes emerging compliance and security risks. Secondary but growing position in disclosure.

risks.title: Middle East Geopolitical Conflict
risks.score_rationale: Three production sites and 500 employees in Israel. Current conflicts have already caused disruptions. Threats of resumption or escalation, with risk of sanctions, supply chain breaks or plant closures. Alarmist language and current context reinforce severity. Detailed mention in 10-K.

risks.title: Multiple Legal Disputes
risks.score_rationale: Company faces frequent litigation across multiple areas (competition, data protection, product liability). While current impact deemed non-material, adverse judgment could have significant effect. Repeated mention and linkage to other regulatory risks.

risks.title: Third-Party Vendor Concentration
risks.score_rationale: Strengthened framework for assessing third-party risks, with standardized questionnaires and validations. Risk of security incidents or non-compliance through partners. Detailed mention of control processes indicates significant exposure. Recent acquisition integration adds vendor dependency.

risks.title: Zoetis Acquisition Integration
risks.score_rationale: Major 297.5M acquisition financed through debt, adding 37 products and 6 sites. Risk of operational, cultural and financial integration. Results inclusion noted, but no synergy guarantee. Increased leverage heightens financial pressure.

risks.title: International Regulatory Compliance
risks.score_rationale: Operations in 90 countries subject to varying laws (data protection, environment, competition). Risk of cross-border sanctions. Explicit mention in potential litigation. Compliance framework in place but complexity growing due to geography.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or related technologies in the provided documents. The company does not appear to position AI as a strategic lever.
evidence: No reference to AI, machine learning, or advanced automation in the 10-K
